name: Orenthil Whisperwind
summary: Orenthil Whisperwind is a night elf resident of Teldrassil, commonly encountered resting under the boughs of Dolanaar. He serves as an welcoming liaison for rare travelers, presenting gifts sent across the world to newly arrived champions. Given his prominent surname, many wonder whether he shares kinship with High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind herself.

sections.title: A Friendly Face in Teldrassil
sections.body: Standing amidst the shaded terraces of Dolanaar, Orenthil Whisperwind offers a quiet welcome to fledgling adventurers emerging from Shadowglen. While he remains modest and keeps mostly to himself beneath the canopy of the World Tree, he is notably tasked with greeting select travelers and delivering special companion creatures to those carrying rare tokens from abroad.

sections.title: The Whisperwind Line
sections.body: Bearing the name Whisperwind immediately invites speculation in night elven lands. While Orenthil has never made grand claims of nobility or spiritual authority, his surname suggests potential ties to High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind. Whether he belongs to an extended branch of her ancestral line or merely shares an ancient Kaldorei family name remains a point of quiet curiosity among passing travelers.

faq.answer: He is a night elf found in Dolanaar on Teldrassil. He serves as a welcoming figure for adventurers setting out into the boughs of the World Tree.

faq.q: Is Orenthil related to Tyrande Whisperwind?
faq.answer: His surname suggests he may be part of the extended family or ancestral lineage of High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind, though he does not flaunt high station or claim direct power in Darnassus.

faq.q: Where can I find Orenthil Whisperwind?
faq.answer: Orenthil resides in Dolanaar, the first major settlement night elf adventurers encounter after departing Shadowglen in central Teldrassil.
He offers the quest 'Welcome!', which allows travelers bearing special collector tokens to claim an exotic companion pet to accompany them on their journeys.

angles.text: Meeting a Kaldorei who shares the name of High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind in humble Dolanaar serves as an early reminder of the sprawling, ancient history behind Kalimdor's elven bloodlines.
